signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a single-story ranch house from across a large front lawn; some tree shade, and a vehicle at the far right edge is partly hidden by shrubs.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Foundation shrubs are rounded and tidy and the lawn is mowed, but there is no crew, equipment, or other clear sign of professional service.

signals.notes: Well-kept ranch home on a spacious corner lot with mature trees and a covered front porch; one dark vehicle is partially visible at the right edge near the driveway or side of the house.
